rows.behavior: Validate the typed act and its public authentication evidence, preserve its structural identifier and record an atomic receipt. A receipt is not final membership, admission or publication; return its durable status and permit status recovery by act identifier.
rows.name: submit-act

rows.behavior: Select an admitted published epoch at an explicit boundary and return its standing or title projection with epoch, declaration and publication references. Do not recompute with current declarations or expose a candidate as published.
rows.name: read-published

rows.behavior: The API owners admit named domain reads, their contextual discovery and preview before service. Exact payload bytes follow (`inv:design:fixed-payload-carriage`); typed projections are distinct read results under (`inv:api:document-bytes`). The first historical read continues to return its exact version-one document under (`inv:api:document-bytes`).
rows.name: fetch-publication

rows.behavior: Return the disclosed causes, declaration editions and exact evidence documents named by the historical package or, after admission, by the epoch record under (`inv:design:epoch-reference-authority`). A bounded page states its scope and continuation; only the verifier can establish complete reconstruction. The replay crate consumes these public bytes without server-side replay authority.
rows.name: replay-inputs

rows.behavior: Dispatch only when the optional exact raw service is enabled for the selected snapshot. Report unsupported when absent and preserve its explicit resource or comparison outcomes. Never substitute an approximate partial traversal for the exact service or feed terminal results into admission.
rows.name: raw-service

rows.behavior: Only in the declared development run, validate the recipient and exact amount, reserve the published quotas and funds, and return the durable grant state or its attributable refusal. Recover by run/request identifier; a grant is not a burn and supplies no standing.
rows.name: faucet
